نبذة

Incredibly proud of the fun, safe and inclusive salon – Chelsea and the team are passionate about coming to work for great clients in a delicious kitsch and colourful space. A space that inspires creativity, individuality and self expression. Through the collective experience of the team, Miss Jay’s staff deliver a breadth of services and in a truly comfortable space. Chelsea has worked hard to create strong relationships with her clientele and build a reputation of inclusion for everyone regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race or religion.

  • Step 4: Add ons including Treatments And Repairs (Add To Mani/Pedi Or Book A Repair)
  • Step 5 - Nail Art - Anything Beyond Solid Colour
  • Pedicures
  • Manicure & Pedicure Combo
  • Wax/Tint/Henna
  • Lash Perming
  • Facial Beauty Combos
  • Threading
  • Training/Workshop

A thoughtful, inclusive approach is at the heart of Miss Jay's Nails - Thornbury, where nail technicians are praised for gentle, attentive care and meticulous results. Clients appreciate the welcoming atmosphere and clear guidance, whether choosing a gel polish manicure or BIAB refills, and leave feeling comfortable, cared for, and delighted with their nails.
